subject: Kickoff: cell painting embedding service (H1)
body:
Hi Jelena,

Kicking off the cell painting embeddings effort formally. Goal: turn the notebook we open-sourced into an internal embedding service for high-content screening. The method is proven — it backed our SLAS Discovery paper — and the pipeline is simple: 5-stain input images, deep network features, then a random projection matrix to get the final embedding.

Product framing: partners upload plates, we return per-well embeddings they can cluster for mechanism-of-action calls. No model training on their side.

Rough milestones inside our window (Feb 16 – May 4): parity with the published notebook by mid-March, batch API on Titan by early April, launch review before end of April. Sample data stays BBBC025 until Legal clears partner plates.

Can you send a staffing + compute sketch by Friday?

Thanks,
Lucia
